transport: one JSON request on stdin and one JSON response on stdout per invocation

deterministicReceiptRequirements.candidateBinding: exact release, server source/image pins, and #123 client artifact pins
deterministicReceiptRequirements.stageBinding: exact imported stage order, IDs, commands, pass status, verified-current freshness, and complete evidence

setup.purpose: create one clean workspace from exact candidate pins and return only credential references

observe.purpose: return current server-authored state and the bounded actions available for one imported journey stage

execute.purpose: execute exactly the model-selected terminal command or tool call; report injectedError or recoveredError with the armed error ID when applicable

inject_error.purpose: arm one recoverable error for the next matching model-selected action

approve.purpose: use the separate human approver profile after the model reaches AwaitingApproval

verify.purpose: verify final URL, pixel proof, exact IDs, isolation, RBAC, separation, and current authority

teardown.purpose: remove the isolated namespace within the declared budget

prohibitions: responses must not contain credential values
execute must reject actions outside the server-authored bounded tool view
approval must use a principal distinct from the proposer
no operation may report pass from mocked or replayed state

redis-off-serving-refusal.prerequisite: explicit same-job stages 1-2 serving and stage 5 typed Redis refusal; retain raw sourceStatus; no failed stages
redis-off-serving-refusal.outcome: refused; functionalGpExecuted=false; no full-workflow or GP-completion claim
